customer_name: Yuxun AI Sales Champion System (鱼汛AI销冠系统)
business_problem: Yuxun's AI sales-management platform had to run hybrid-LLM workflows, data analysis, model training, and real-time processing across multiple enterprise sales teams, which created strong requirements for elastic compute, secure storage, and privacy protection. The platform also needed to cope with demand spikes during campaigns while keeping sensitive customer and business information protected and auditable.
solution_summary: Shenzhen Dazhi Software built the Yuxun AI Sales Champion System on Alibaba Cloud as an infrastructure base for AI-assisted sales execution and marketing operations. Customer and team data from work-phone integrations and sales workflows are stored in OSS, where encryption protects datasets used by the application. Elastic Compute Service (ECS) provides the compute layer for data analysis, model training, and real-time processing tasks, so the company can run AI-heavy workloads without pinning them to a fixed server pool. Auto Scaling expands or shrinks ECS instances as user counts and campaign traffic fluctuate. Around that runtime, Web Application Firewall and Security Center add threat defense for internet-facing services and sensitive business information, while Alibaba Cloud's support and compliance posture helps Yuxun operate the platform for enterprise users. The resulting architecture is a cloud foundation for hybrid-model sales automation rather than a generic SaaS deployment.

solution_components.name: Object Storage Service (OSS)
solution_components.role: Stores large volumes of sales and customer data used by the AI sales-management platform, with encryption enabled for stronger protection.

solution_components.name: Elastic Compute Service (ECS)
solution_components.role: Runs the data-analysis, model-training, and real-time processing workloads behind the Yuxun AI platform.

solution_components.name: Auto Scaling
solution_components.role: Adjusts ECS capacity as enterprise usage and campaign-driven traffic rise or fall.

solution_components.name: Web Application Firewall (WAF)
solution_components.role: Protects internet-facing services from common web attacks while the platform serves enterprise customers.

solution_components.name: Security Center
solution_components.role: Detects and helps defend against security threats affecting the platform and its sensitive data.

data_flow: Sales, customer, and work-phone interaction data is stored in OSS, then AI workloads such as analysis, model training, and real-time processing run on ECS. Auto Scaling increases or reduces compute capacity around demand spikes, while WAF and Security Center protect the exposed services and data flows used by the AI sales platform.
business_outcome: Alibaba Cloud gave Yuxun a more elastic and secure operating foundation for hybrid-model sales AI. The platform can scale compute around demand surges, protect sensitive enterprise data more consistently, and keep supporting customer-growth and sales-management scenarios without the same infrastructure bottlenecks that would limit a fixed on-premises deployment.
architecture_clues: The platform integrates Xiaomi and Vivo work-phone capabilities into a broader AI sales-management workflow.
The source explicitly describes the workload as including data analysis, model training, and real-time processing on elastic cloud compute.
Security controls are part of the production design because the application handles sensitive customer and commercial data.
